body: Blueface gave fans a closer look at his upgraded face tattoos, with several of his existing designs getting a fresh touch-up. The updates include his Benjamin Franklin portrait, casino chips, Maybach emblem and a Bentley logo with the letter “C. ” This comes shortly after he got Chrisean Rock’s name tattooed across his back during a livestream.
